summary:
AstraCare – Astronaut Health Monitor

AstraCare is a web-based application developed to monitor astronaut health information and spacecraft environmental conditions through a centralized dashboard. The main aim of this project is to make monitoring information easy to access, understand, and manage in one place.

The application includes different sections such as Dashboard, Crew Members, Health Monitoring, Environment, Alerts, and Reports. The dashboard provides an overview of crew health and mission status. The Crew Members section displays astronaut details, while Health Monitoring and Environment provide relevant health and environmental information. The Alerts section helps identify warning conditions, and Reports organizes monitoring information.

AstraCare addresses the challenge of managing different types of monitoring information separately by bringing them together in a single platform. This makes information more organized and easier to understand.

This project is important because astronaut health and safety are essential during space missions. A centralized monitoring system can help improve awareness of crew health and environmental conditions. We developed this application using Python and Flask for the backend, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the frontend, GitHub for version control, and Render for deployment.
details: AstraCare is a web-based astronaut health monitoring application designed to display crew details, health information, spacecraft environmental conditions, alerts, and reports in one centralized dashboard. It helps organize monitoring information, identify warning conditions, and improve awareness of astronaut health and safety during space missions. The project provides a simple, user-friendly interface and combines multiple monitoring sections in one platform. We developed it using Python, Flask, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with GitHub for version control and Render for deployment. Our team considered astronaut safety, easy access to information, user-friendly design, clear alerts, and future improvements. AstraCare aims to support better monitoring and management of astronaut-related information, with the potential to include real-time sensor monitoring in the future.
